_doc: Exception ledger for scripts/check_soak_doctrine.py CHECK D. A decision gate must not make a verdict control-dependent on live-outcome or calendar accrual (docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md § 'Promotion evidence — offline edge, live mechanics', clause 3). This file declares the branches that ALREADY do, so the check can be armed today without failing CI on a repair that is Tier-3 and therefore not a session's to make. IT IS A RATCHET, NOT A WAIVER: the count must match EXACTLY — one more fails as a new violation, one fewer fails as a stale ledger — so the number can only be walked DOWN. Every entry is VERIFIED: backlog_row must name a row that actually exists in a review backlog, because a ledger cheaper to lie to than to satisfy is worse than no ledger.
_how_to_lower: Land the Tier-3 repair, re-run `python3 scripts/check_soak_doctrine.py`, and set known_accrual_gated_branches to the number it reports. The guard fails until the ledger matches, so the count cannot be left behind.
_how_to_raise: Do not, without an operator decision. Raising it declares a NEW branch that contradicts binding canon. It needs a reason recorded here, an existing backlog row, and the operator's call — it is not a way to get a PR green.

scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py.reason: The M7 daily strategy-review gate grades every leg's verdict off live in-window closes. Six branches select a threshold tier from `n` (bound from `headline.n_closed`) — including the `n < MIN_CLOSED_FOR_ACTION` floor that forces HOLD — and Override 4 is a literal `shadow_soak_days < 14` promotion gate, the 'N days at stage' construct clause 3 names verbatim as 'a policy artifact, not evidence'. Measured effect: 52 of 52 legs graded `hold` on eight consecutive days (2026-09-01..09-08), actionable 0 every day.
scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py.why_not_fixed_here: Changing these branches changes what a KILL/DEMOTE/PROMOTE verdict rests on, which is Tier-3 (operator-approved). MI-215 proposes the repair in docs/design/strategy-leg-offline-edge-basis-PROPOSAL.md and does not enact it.
scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py.not_a_fix: Lowering MIN_CLOSED_FOR_ACTION or widening the window reduces this count by ZERO -- the branches remain, re-scaled -- because under the model no setting of either makes a live count an edge basis. THE MODEL, which is what to carry rather than a ban on asking: edge is established OFFLINE (purged walk-forward CV, replay_pregate_fleet, the point-in-time backfills); live data establishes MECHANICS only, at 1-2 executed trades rather than calendar time; SLOW LIVE ACCRUAL IS A FEATURE OF THIS SYSTEM, NOT A BARRIER, so `none_gradeable` on a live window is not a defect; and fewer legs does not raise trades-per-leg. The count falls only when a verdict stops being control-dependent on accrual at all. Ask about the window and the floor freely -- the operator retracted the earlier prohibition on 2026-09-09 ('the problem isn't the question, it's the underlying misunderstanding of infra and processes'); what was wrong with the four options put to them was the model underneath, not that they were asked.
scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py.narrowed_note: MI-217 did NOT lower this count and deliberately did not try. It made the ABSENCE of offline evidence legible: where the gate would have said `hold` for want of live closes AND no offline record exists, it now says `no_offline_evidence`. But the branches still key on n_closed / MIN_CLOSED_FOR_ACTION, so they remain accrual-gated and are still counted here, correctly. Count UNCHANGED at 7; only the line numbers moved. The repair that LOWERS it is the larger Tier-3 change of sourcing the EDGE verdict from the offline record, which is not what was approved.
scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py.backlog_row_note: Re-pointed 2026-09-21 by the operating reset. Was BL-20260909-STRATEGY-REVIEW-PACKET-GRADES-EDGE-OFF-A-LIVE-WINDOW-WHICH-THE-PROMOTION-EVIDENCE-RULE-FORBIDS, a row in the now-archived health-review backlog. The SAME finding is carried by checklist item B4 ('Re-scope the review packet -- Stage 2 on money, Stage 1 on cost fidelity'), which is the repair. The row was re-pointed, not dropped: an entry naming a row that does not exist is how a real finding gets silenced, and that is what this ledger's own _doc warns about.
